newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline says FDA expands Havrix use.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline says FDA expands Havrix use.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc said on Thursday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared its Havrix product to be used as a preventive for hepatitis A in people with chronic liver disease.
SmithKline Beecham said in a news release that an estimated 5 million Americans suffer from one or more forms of chronic liver disease.
Havrix already is available for people who may be exposed to hepatitis A, but the FDA ruling allows SmithKline Beecham to promote the product specifically for people with chronic liver disease.
